svg.aria-label: Example of program execution on a hypothetical machine with 16-bit instructions (4-bit opcode, 12-bit address). Locations 300 to 302 hold LOAD 940, ADD 941 and STORE 941; locations 940 and 941 hold 3 and 2. Six snapshots show PC, AC, IR and memory after each fetch and execute: AC becomes 3, then 5, and 5 is stored in location 941
svg.text: opcodes: 1 = load AC from memory · 5 = add to AC from memory · 2 = store AC to memory (values in hex)
